newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay shares close up on technical factors.
newsitem.headline: Bombay shares close up on technical factors.

text.p: ** (1045 GMT) Technical factors on the last day of weekly
account push Bombay shares up
** Benchmark Bombay index gains 46.07 pts to a 4,351.83
provisional close
** ITC rallies for second straight day as
short-sellers cover positions
** Tata Tea firms on expectations of strong earnings growth in the current year--traders
Frantic short covering on the last day of the weekly account boosted Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) prices on Friday, brokers said.
"We saw choppy trade," said Maulik Sharedalal, a BSE member-broker. "There was clear evidence of hectic short covering on the last day."
Tobacco conglomerate ITC Ltd led the surge for the second straight day, as short-sellers squared their business at the close of the "no-delivery period".
"Accumulated positions of last five weeks were squared-off," Sharedalal said. "The short positions were large."
A no-delivery period is when a company closes its books. Market players get a longer time to close business during the period as against the usual weekly settlements.
ITC rose 24 rupees to 539.
The rise was also aided by reports on Thursday that the company's net profit had risen 34 percent in the first quarter of 1997/98 (April-March), traders said.
Sharedalal said Tata Tea was boosted by expectations of a 40 percent increase in earnings this year.
The stock rose 21 rupees to 429.
Shares of Larsen & Toubro rose 3.5 rupees to 273. After the market closed, the engineering giant said its sales rose 23 percent in the first quarter of 1997/98 (April-March).
Sales climbed to 12.69 billion rupees from 10.32 billion in the year-ago period, the firm said in a statement.
It bagged orders worth 15.38 billion rupees in the first quarter and hopes to see business pick up in the second half.
Central bank intervention pulled the rupee briefly below 35.82 to a dollar, but it closed at 35.78/79 after starting at 35.705/710.
--Bombay equities desk 91-22-265-9000
